title: EmbedProof emissions report v1
description: Operator report for one installation and month (docs/INTERFACES.md section 4). This schema covers the structure and ranges that attestor/report.py enforces. Rules that need other data are NOT expressible here and are enforced by the attestor only: indirectEmissionsTco2 within 1% of electricityMwh x gridFactorTco2PerMwh; seeTco2PerT within 1% of (directEmissionsTco2 + indirectEmissionsTco2) / productionTonnes; route equal to the on-chain registry route; productionTonnes at most the on-chain nameplate capacity / 12 x 1.2; period not later than the current UTC month; the installation being registered. Numbers must be JSON numbers no larger than 2^53 - 1 (RFC 8785 / JavaScript interoperability).

installationId.description: Installation id as registered on-chain (ASCII, right-padded to bytes32).

cnCode.description: CBAM Combined Nomenclature code, 4 to 8 digits.

productionTonnes.description: Tonnes of product in the period; whole tonnes are attested, so at least 1.

seeTco2PerT.description: Specific embedded emissions, tCO2 per tonne of product. round(see x 1e4) is stored as a uint32 on-chain, so it must stay below 429496.7296.
